name: Tripo
description: Make 3D models with your own Tripo API key and Tripo credits, not Genex credits.

tools.name: status
tools.description: Read the Tripo account state, the API wallet balance and the recent Tripo tasks for this game. Free; spends nothing.

tools.name: generate
tools.description: Start one paid Tripo task with the user's own Tripo credits, wait up to about two and a half minutes, then download the result into the game. Operations: text_to_model (needs prompt), image_to_model (needs image, a project-relative png/jpg/webp, or options.imageUrl), and with id set to an earlier Tripo task id: texture_model, animate_prerigcheck, animate_rig, animate_retarget (options.animation, for example "preset:run"), stylize_model, convert_model. options holds other Tripo API fields such as model_version, face_limit, texture, pbr, texture_quality, negative_prompt, out_format. If the result says running, call tripo__retrieve with the taskId; never call generate again for the same request.

image.description: Project-relative image for image_to_model. Do not use absolute paths.

id.description: The Tripo task id of the model to work on, for every operation except text_to_model and image_to_model.

options.description: Extra Tripo API fields as an object; type, file and original_model_task_id are set by the plugin.

tools.confirmation: Start a paid Tripo task with your own Tripo API key. Tripo charges your Tripo wallet.

tools.name: retrieve
tools.description: Wait for an existing Tripo task and download its result into the game. Free; never starts a new task. Pass the taskId that tripo__generate returned.

skills.name: tripo
skills.text: Tripo makes 3D models with the user's own Tripo API key and Tripo credits. Call tripo__status first; when connected is false, tell the user once to press Connect on the Tripo plugin and paste a key, and do not block other work. Use tripo__generate only for assets the game really needs. Every call asks the user first; a declined or expired request must not be repeated unless the user asks again. When generate returns status running, call tripo__retrieve with its taskId until it is success or failed; never submit the same request twice. Load the exact returned files (for example with GLTFLoader) and check them in the running game. To rig or animate a model, pass its taskId as id: animate_prerigcheck, then animate_rig, then animate_retarget with options.animation. Respect explicit user choices such as Genex credits, Local Blender or procedural-only assets; never switch between paid services silently.

actions.name: disconnect
actions.label: Disconnect Tripo
actions.confirmation: Remove the saved Tripo API key from Studio. Tasks already started on Tripo keep running.
